name: open-tessera
description: Database agent runtime, adapters, tools, and Tessera Studio.

scripts.build:packages: turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' && bun run check:source
scripts.release:check: bun run check:naming && bun run check:boundaries && bun run typecheck && bun run build:packages && bun run test && bun scripts/check-release.ts && bun scripts/check-release-stage.ts
scripts.test: bun run check:naming && bun run check:boundaries && turbo run test
scripts.test:ci: bun run check:naming && bun run check:boundaries && turbo run test
